note: Top panel -- renders: fixed navigation buttons, search controls, and view switchers
Top panel buttons -- renders: fixed action buttons for file operations
Top panel toggles -- renders: fixed view mode options (list, grid, etc.)
Top panel radios -- renders: fixed sort criteria (name, date, size, etc.)
Top panel checkboxes -- renders: fixed filter options (file type, date range, etc.)
Top panel labels -- renders: fixed section labels and property names
